keep_features.feature_value: Uses slang/colloquial phrasing like “cool n valid” and “uncivilized behavior”
keep_features.rationale: Contains colloquial slang and informal phrasing rather than formal argumentation.

keep_features.feature_value: Judges behavior as irresponsible/jerkish; accountability and responsibility framed morally
keep_features.rationale: Uses moral/ethical evaluation terms (responsibility, uncivilized, blame/accountability).

keep_features.feature_value: Mocks a politician as “entirely empty” and personality as what they saw on Fox
keep_features.evidence_span: "his entire personality is just whatever he saw on Fox news"
keep_features.rationale: Uses derogatory characterization to belittle the target actor.

keep_features.feature_value: Blames conservatives/liberals as groups that “love” the media/personalities
keep_features.rationale: Assigns blame/praise via collective in-group/out-group labeling.

keep_features.feature_value: “Think that would be a good one to apply…” and “So, yeah…” policy stance building
keep_features.evidence_span: "Think that would be a good one to apply to Cops as well."
keep_features.rationale: Implied recommendation contingent on a comparative scenario (apply X to Y).

keep_features.feature_value: Claims stopping measurement means climate change becomes unreal / climate policy causal logic
keep_features.evidence_span: "if we stop looking, maybe it'll stop being real."
keep_features.rationale: States a cause-effect relationship in the climate-policy critique.

keep_features.feature_value: Direct imperative style urging action (“Scare the fuck…”)
keep_features.evidence_span: "Scare the fuck out of the white people."
keep_features.rationale: Uses command-like wording rather than descriptive narration.

keep_features.evidence_span: "Less money for war and more money for social programs"

remove_features.feature_value: High historical marker reference (1776) and rights amendment reference
remove_features.rationale: Uses a specific date and rights framework to anchor the argument.

remove_features.feature_value: Demographic replacement framed as deliberate “damndest to stop it”
remove_features.evidence_span: "are doing their damndest to stop it."
remove_features.rationale: Treats group actions as coordinated to counter an anticipated demographic shift.

remove_features.feature_value: Uses profanity/intensifier and dismissive slang (“copium”, “drop this shit”)
remove_features.rationale: Contains internet slang and dismissive profanity.
Uses explicit taboo language targeting two political ideologies.

remove_features.evidence_span: "turn their viewers and listeners into mindless zombies"
remove_features.rationale: Employs mocking dehumanization rather than substantive critique.

remove_features.feature_value: Presents broad claims about trends (“continue to rise no matter who's power”)
remove_features.evidence_span: "Avg. global temperature...continue to rise no matter who's power."
remove_features.rationale: States general empirical-sounding assertions without hedging.

remove_features.feature_value: Advocacy/statement to redefine term (“women's rights are not anti-men”)
remove_features.rationale: Normatively frames a principle against a perceived misunderstanding.

remove_features.feature_value: Gendered actor identification plus endorsement with party/issue contrast (gun control vs Parkland/AIPAC)
remove_features.rationale: Contains explicit identification of an elected official and ties their issue positions to constituency events/donations.
